## 🚦 Definition of Ready (DoR)
Before a task is pulled into the active sprint, verify that:
* [ ] The issue has a clear title and description.
* [ ] Acceptance criteria or expected results are explicitly stated.
* [ ] Dependencies and potential blockers are identified.
* [ ] The task has been estimated or prioritized.

---

## 🏁 Definition of Done (DoD)
To close a task and move it to **Done**, ensure:
* [ ] Code is peer-reviewed via Pull Request and approved.
* [ ] Automated tests pass without errors.
* [ ] Changes are verified/tested in a local or staging environment.
* [ ] Relevant documentation (e.g., Postman collections, README) is updated.
